messages:
tara: quick question: what's everyone's go-to 40min wind-down playlist + one short film under 90min? prefer warm vibes, no heavy synth.
noah: heres my 40min: 
1. Norah Jones - Dont Know Why (3:07)
2. Otis Redding - These Arms of Mine (2:29)
3. Nick Drake - Pink Moon (2:03)
4. Rodriguez - Sugar Man (3:55)
5. Iron & Wine - Passing Afternoon (3:12)
6. Joni Mitchell - A Case Of You (4:20)
7. Jose Gonzlez - Heartbeats (2:37)
8. Sufjan Stevens - To Be Alone With You (2:07)
9. Laura Marling - What He Wrote (4:03)
10. Elliott Smith - Between The Bars (2:23)
11. The Tallest Man On Earth - The Gardener (3:33)
12. Fleet Foxes - Blue Ridge Mountains (5:09)

ravi: short film rec: "The Lunch Date" (1989) ~12min but charming; for slightly longer, "The Fall" (2006) is ~2h but gorgeous if you're in the mood.
mei: adding: if you want something mid-century, watch "Once" (~90min) for music + warmth.
noah: also throwing in midnight snack idea: tea + toasted almond cookies.
jukebox-bot: saved noah's playlist to #random-playlists (link: https://open.spotify/placeholder) :cd:
tara: lovely, thanks! meeting this weekend? maybe a 40min listening hour and a short-film screening afterwards.
mei: down for saturday afternoon.
ravi: saturday works.
noah: i can bring a record player if folks want vinyl vibes.
